summary: Evaluation of Redwood Private VPC for production RegTech workloads. Needs SOC 2 / ISO mapping, HIPAA BAA language for subset of PHI, KMS integration (BYOK preferred), and PCI scoping confirmation. 6-week POC planned in EU region.
notes: Intro call 2026-01-28 w/ CTO Anika Patel + Head of Security Gunnar - initial interest in Private VPC due to EU residency + HIPAA for clinical datasets.
Security review kickoff 2026-02-10 (Fireflies ff-20260210-84c1). Provided network diagram and proposed VPC architecture. They asked for private control plane option and audit log locations.
POC scope agreed 2026-02-15: 6-week pilot, EU region, 2 dedicated GPU nodes, BYOK KMS integration, detailed audit log retention (7 yrs), prefix/KV caching disabled for PHI flows.
Vendor questionnaire: Mariner requires SOC 2 Type II evidence + ISO 27001 certificate and an itemized mapping showing where Redwood controls meet their control objectives.

HIPAA / BAA: Legal requested draft BAA language; they will segregate PHI ingress into a dedicated on-prem stub if needed. Need confirmation on where audit logs containing metadata are stored and retention settings.

PCI considerations: Payments metadata will be tokenized before ingestion but Mariner's PCI team wants a scoping note describing what Redwood persists in logs and whether tokenization is reversible on our side.

KMS notes: Preference is BYOK with HSM-backed keys; need architecture note showing key rotation, access logs, and Redwood's ability to integrate with customer KMS (Azure Key Vault / AWS KMS / GCP KMS).
Cost/contract: Proposal (tiered) shared 2026-02-18 (see drive doc). Asked for committed capacity discounts for Dedicated pool after POC.
Quote feedback: SE asked to tighten latency SLOs for chat use-case (target p95 < 120ms for short prompts) and confirm autoscaling behavior during surge.
Customer quote: 'We cannot send PHI through a public control plane — we need proof of separation and retention controls.'
Next scheduled: Architecture deep-dive with Mariner Sec + Infra on 2026-03-05 to finalize KMS approach and audit log locations.
